Author: Rayla Petal
Name: Cummy
Description:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Punchline: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Changelog:
- The droplet now lists only Cummy users: your partners, plus other Cummy users nearby. Nobody without Cummy gets a stray message any more. Cummy finds other users through SimpleHeels, carried by your sync service (Lightless, Mare...), so you need SimpleHeels and to be synced with them. Without SimpleHeels, only partners are listed.
- For other Cummy users you can now see whether they're in Pairing or Public mode and which parts they block: you can layer, lick or creampie them when you're both in Public mode, otherwise just pair. Players you're synced with can see your mode and blocks the same way.
- People on older Cummy versions won't show up as nearby strangers until they update; partners always do.
